title: 33rd Sunday in Ordinary Time
description: Liturgical Sunday Masses. The 8:30 AM High Mass features choral ministration by St. Cecilia Choir. CMO monthly general meeting follows the 8:30 AM Mass in the Father's Hall.

title: Exposition & Adoration of the Blessed Sacrament
description: Weekly parish holy hour featuring silent adoration, guided meditation, litany of the Holy Eucharist, and solemn Benediction.

title: Presentation of the Blessed Virgin Mary (Memorial)
description: Memorial Mass of the Blessed Virgin Mary followed by Legion of Mary weekly devotions and Infant Baptism instruction class at 9:00 AM.

title: Solemnity of Christ the King & Parish Eucharistic Procession
description: Solemn High Mass at 8:30 AM marking the close of the liturgical year. At 2:00 PM, all parishioners participate in the grand Eucharistic Procession carrying the Blessed Sacrament through major streets of Ugbolu.

title: Sacrament of Holy Baptism for Infants
description: Administration of the Sacrament of Baptism to infants whose parents and sponsors have completed catechetical preparation.

title: First Sunday of Advent (Liturgical Year C Begins)
description: Lighting of the First Candle of the Advent Wreath (The Candle of Hope). The sacred season of preparation for the Nativity of our Lord commences. Parish Advent Novena announced.

title: Feast of Saint Andrew, Apostle & Parish Advent Novena Kick-off
description: Feast of St. Andrew, brother of Simon Peter. The 9-day Parish Advent Revival Novena begins at 5:30 PM with holy rosary, preaching, and evening Mass.

title: Second Sunday of Advent
description: Lighting of the Second Advent Candle (The Candle of Peace). Scripture theme: 'Prepare the way of the Lord' (St. John the Baptist). CWO monthly meeting follows 8:30 AM Mass.

title: Solemnity of the Immaculate Conception (Holy Day of Obligation)
description: Patronal Feast of the Catholic Church in Nigeria. Holy Day of Obligation. Masses at 6:00 AM and 6:00 PM followed by consecration prayers at the Marian Grotto.

title: Holy Matrimony & Society of St. Vincent de Paul Meeting
description: Nuptial Mass uniting Brother Emeka Osakwe and Sister Blessing Umeh in Christian marriage. Society of St. Vincent de Paul general meeting holds at 3:00 PM.

title: Third Sunday of Advent (Gaudete Sunday)
description: Gaudete Sunday: 'Rejoice in the Lord always!' Lighting of the Third Advent Candle (The Candle of Joy). Parish youth end-of-year thanksgiving preparation.

title: Parish Advent Penitential Service (General Confessions)
description: Solemn penitential service followed by individual confessions with visiting priests from the Asaba Deanery, Catholic Diocese of Issele-Uku.

title: Fourth Sunday of Advent & Festival of Nine Lessons and Carols
description: Fourth Sunday of Advent (The Candle of Love). At 5:00 PM, the parish hosts the grand annual Christmas Festival of Nine Lessons and Carols with guest choral groups.

title: Christmas Eve: Midnight Vigil Mass
description: Carol prelude by the choir followed by the Holy Vigil Mass of the Nativity of the Lord with the blessing of the Parish Nativity Crèche.

title: The Nativity of the Lord (Christmas Day)
description: Solemn Christmas Day Masses celebrating the Incarnation of our Lord. Administration of First Holy Communion to catechism children during the 8:30 AM Mass.

title: New Year's Eve Crossover Vigil & Te Deum of Thanksgiving
description: Eucharistic Adoration, chanting of the solemn Te Deum hymn in thanksgiving for the departing year, and midnight Crossover Mass into the New Year.

title: Solemnity of Mary, Mother of God (World Day of Peace)
description: Holy Day of Obligation inaugurating the New Year under the maternal protection of the Blessed Virgin Mary.

title: Feast of the Conversion of Saint Paul the Apostle
description: Patronal Feast in honour of our co-patron Saint Paul the Apostle. Concluding Mass of the Week of Prayer for Christian Unity.

title: Feast of the Chair of Saint Peter the Apostle
description: Patronal Feast honoring the episcopal teaching authority and pastoral ministry of our co-patron Saint Peter. Special prayers for our Holy Father the Pope and Bishop Michael Elue.

title: Solemnity of Saints Peter and Paul (Parish Feast Day)
description: Grand Parish Feast Day celebration. Pontifical High Mass with the Bishop of Issele-Uku Diocese, confirmation of candidates, cultural presentations by parish pious societies, and parish feast reception.
